SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 TEK MATERNITETI I RI-BRRYLI
Jeni ne kerkim te nje apartamenti te tipologjise 2+1 per blerje brenda Unazes se Vogel tek zona e Brrylit?
Kemi apartamentin e duhur ne nje nga zonat me te mira te kryeqytetit sic eshte zona e Brrylit qe ofron qetesi dhe siguri.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat te ri te mireadministruar te pajisur me ashensor dhe sistem kapot.
Organizohet ne nje korridor, ambient ndenje perfshi ambientin e gatimit, 1 ballkon, 2 dhoma gjumi dhe 1 tualet me dritare.
Arredimi eshte bere me arkitekt dhe apartamenti eshte i mobiluar me markat me prestigjoze dhe cilesore si ne elektroshtepiake ashtu edhe ne pajisjet hidrosanitare; i pajisur me kondicioner; totalisht i investuar dhe i shtruar me parket dhe ka ndricim led.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Zona ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode pasi ofron larmi sherbimesh, akses me transportin publik dhe privat, shkolla, kopshte, çerdhe, spitale, universitete shteterore dhe private, markete, bar kafe, restorante etj.
Per nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni!
description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT MATERNITY I RI-BRYLI Are you looking for a 2+1 type apartment for purchase within the Small Ring in the area of ​​Brylli? We have the right apartment in one of the best areas of the capital, such as the Bryl area, which offers peace and security. The apartment is located in a new, well-managed building equipped with an elevator and elevator system. It is organized in a corridor, living room including kitchen, 1 balcony, 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom with window. The furnishing was done by an architect and the apartment is furnished with the most prestigious and quality brands, both in electrical appliances and in hydrosanitary equipment; equipped with air conditioning; fully invested and laid with parquet and has LED lighting. Has regular mortgage documentation. The area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life as it offers a variety of services, access to public and private transport, schools, kindergartens, nurseries, hospitals, state and private universities, markets, coffee bars, restaurants, etc. For a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me!
